summary.text: Jim Harris is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 16, running against incumbent Republican Carson Smith Jr. in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey he named affordability, health care, education, and transparency and integrity as his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Harris graduated from West Bloomfield High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as retired.
He said his transparency and integrity priorities include a ban on trading while in office, free and fair election maps, campaign finance reform and term limits.
